appDescription: A vehicle feature learning assistant that guides parked drivers through supported settings and records their reported experience.

function.name: SET_TUTORIAL_MODE
function.description: Enable or disable contextual vehicle feature tutorials.

enabled.description: Whether the tutorial mode should be enabled.

function.name: START_FEATURE_GUIDE
function.description: Start a parked feature learning session and request user consent before any supported vehicle operation.

function.name: RESPOND_TO_GUIDE
function.description: Deliver a user response to the active learning session without assuming vehicle execution succeeded.

sessionId.description: The identifier returned by the active guide session.

response.description: The user response, consent, desired temperature or experience report.
